paragraphs: A raw milk cheddar cheese outbreak caused by E. coli O26 has ended, with 18 cases and 9 hospitalizations across 10 states [1]. However, Family Farmstead Dairy, LLC is recalling Raw milk cheddar cheese with a white, red and green label due to potential E. coli contamination; the product was distributed to stores in CT, MA, MD, NJ, NY, PA, and VA [2]. Consumers should discard this product and check their refrigerators [2].

This week brought multiple Class I recalls for Listeria and other serious hazards [3][4][6][8]. Krasnyi Oktyabr Inc recalls Starfish Seafood Cold Smoked Norwegian Salmon contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes, distributed across NY, MA, SC, FL, GA, NV, NJ, OH, and NC [3]. Lidl US TRADING recalls Gelatelli coffee and vanilla gelato with cookie pieces (16 fl oz) contaminated with Listeria, shipped to DC, DE, GA, MD, NC, NJ, NY, PA, SC and VA [4]. WinCo Foods LLC recalls WinCo Foods Hoagie Rolls (6 rolls/bag, 16 oz) for undeclared sesame in CA, ID, MT, NV, OR, UT, and WA [6]. House Foods America Corporation recalls bulk packaged Seitan Cubes due to missing ingredient statement and undeclared wheat allergen [8].

An E. coli outbreak is ongoing at Ohio University, with 16 confirmed cases as of November 16, up from 11 cases on November 13 [15]. A source of the pathogen has not been identified [15]. The FDA is investigating two new Salmonella Enteritidis outbreaks affecting 31 and 14 people respectively, with traceback efforts underway [24].
